tools.name: search_politics
tools.description: Search 567politics reporting, parties, factions, politicians, country systems and policy issues to answer political questions. Accepts a question or keywords; optional country name/slug and kind filters. Read articles with get_article using the returned article_id; read profiles with get_politics_pr

tools.name: get_politics_profile
tools.description: Read a public 567politics party, faction, politician, country-system or issue profile using the exact kind, slug and countrySlug from search_politics. Parties, factions and issues require country. Retain source/review dates, caveats and canonical links; issue scales are not current law or assigned p

tools.name: get_political_spectrum
tools.description: Read 567politics selected party/faction positions and independently sourced politician placements in a supported electoral system. Use the country slug from search_politics. Includes source dates, axes, caveats, chartAvailable and articleMarkdown. Closed dictatorships have profiles/context only. For

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Start optional OAuth sign-in only when the user asks to connect or accepts an invitation. Public research does not require this. Over HTTP, anonymous calls receive an OAuth challenge so the host can open sign-in. After connecting, refresh tools to see personal account features. Does not read or chan

tools.name: get_account_features
tools.description: See what signing in adds: saved lounge-access wallets, home airport, rewards programs, cruise passport, travel map and newsletter preferences. Returns example prompts and instructions to authenticate this assistant. Does not read or change any account; public research needs no login.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: All apps covered by this connector, with canonical home links.

tools.name: search_app_content
tools.description: Search public content from all five apps: Lounge Frog news, Cruises Frog ships and guides, Seats Frog seat maps, Points Frog calculators and news, and 567politics politician profiles, political parties, factions, political-spectrum diagrams, elections, issues and news. Returns verified app page link

tools.name: get_points_program
tools.description: Points Frog program valuation, sourced guide and direct calculator link. Estimates are not guaranteed cash value.

tools.name: get_politics_races
tools.description: Read the current published 567politics race snapshot with provider timestamps. Market prices are not election forecasts. Use search_app_content for individual election and profile page links.

tools.name: search_programs
tools.description: Find credit cards, lounge programs, and airline loyalty programs in the Lounge Frog catalog, with page links. Returns slugs to use with the other tools, plus what each card unlocks.

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: A credit card, lounge network, or airline status program by slug: fee, tiers, the lounge programs it unlocks or the cards that include it, how many open lounges admit its members, and its page link.

tools.name: list_grants
tools.description: Relationships of the form 'holding card X unlocks lounge program Y', with both pages' links. Filter by the granting card or the unlocked lounge program.

tools.name: check_access
tools.description: Given a set of card and lounge-program slugs a traveler holds, list every lounge program they can use and why, with each program's page.

tools.name: get_lounge_metrics
tools.description: The metric slugs a lounge is scored on (1-5) with what a 5 means and each metric's leaderboard page, and the bar-type slugs. Use for the "by" argument of top_lounges.

tools.name: search_lounges
tools.description: Airport lounges on Lounge Frog with their terminal, hours, editorial rating, who gets in, and page link. Narrow by airport ("which lounges are at JFK?"), by a card, lounge network or airline status program the traveler holds (a card stands for every lounge network it unlocks: "which lounges can I us

tools.name: get_lounge
tools.description: Everything about a lounge: where it is (airport, terminal, nearest gate, directions, airside or landside), hours, guest policy, showers and bar, years opened and renovated, website, editorial ratings, every program that admits you with its conditions, and the page links for the lounge, its airport a

tools.name: get_amenity_metrics
tools.description: The metric slugs an airport or a terminal is scored on (1-5: security speed, baggage delivery, ...) with what a 5 means, and the page explaining how Lounge Frog rates them.

tools.name: list_airports
tools.description: Airports in the Lounge Frog directory with their city, country, number of open lounges, editorial rating, and page link. Search by code, name or city, or narrow to one country or to airports with lounges. get_airport has one airport's terminals and lounges.

tools.name: get_airport
tools.description: One airport by IATA code or slug: its editorial ratings, whether you can change terminals airside, and every terminal with the lounges in it, each with its status, rating and page link.

tools.name: list_airlines
tools.description: Airlines on Lounge Frog with their IATA code, slug, founding year, closure date, rating, and page link. Filter by a fragment of the name or code.

tools.name: get_airline
tools.description: One airline in full: code, founding year, where it is based, its hubs, mileage program, customer service number, its safety record, and its page link.

tools.name: list_terminal_airlines
tools.description: The airlines recorded as operating from a terminal, with their page links.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Stories Lounge Frog, Cruises Frog and Points Frog have published (lounge openings, program changes, cruise news, points and miles news), newest first, each with its date, summary and page link. Narrow by site, by words in the headline or summary, or by topic.

tools.name: list_news
tools.description: The articles from other publications that an airport, terminal, lounge, or airline page on Lounge Frog links to, newest first. search_news has the sites' own stories.

tools.name: list_lounge_references
tools.description: Articles and reviews from other publications that a lounge's page links to, newest first.

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: Photos on an airport, terminal, or lounge page, best-voted first, with their credits.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Lounge Frog's guides (a card's or lounge network's lounges at one airport, two cards compared, the best lounges on one metric, editorial lists), featured first, with page links and ids for get_article.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: One published article in full, by id (list_articles gives them), with its page link.

tools.name: search_terminals
tools.description: Find terminals across every airport on Lounge Frog by name, slug, airport code, or city, with their ratings and page links. Returns the slugs get_terminal takes.

tools.name: get_terminal
tools.description: A terminal's amenity ratings and renovation date, the airlines that fly from it, and every lounge inside it.

tools.name: top_lounges
tools.description: The lounge leaderboard the site's Top 100 page is built from, ranked by overall score or by one metric (get_lounge_metrics lists the metric slugs).

tools.name: top_airlines
tools.description: The airline leaderboard, ranked by overall score or by one metric (get_airline_metrics lists the metric slugs).

tools.name: get_airline_metrics
tools.description: The metric slugs an airline is scored on (1-5) with what a 5 means, for the "by" argument of top_airlines.

tools.name: search_iata
tools.description: Search the worldwide IATA airport list, far larger than the lounge directory, by code or by the start of an airport or city name. Resolves a city to the code that get_airport and search_lounges take.

tools.name: get_iata
tools.description: The reference entry for a single 3-letter code: full name, city, country, and kind.

tools.name: list_seatmaps
tools.description: Every airline seat map on Seats Frog (or one airline's), with seat counts by cabin, the date each was checked, and its page link.

tools.name: get_seatmap
tools.description: One airline layout: cabins with pitch, width and layout, the row features and seat notes as saved, and the best and worst seats the site shows.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: Nonstop routes on Lounge Frog's route maps: one airline's, every airline's from one airport (that airport listed first), or both. Each line has the dates, the source page and when it was checked. Also gives the address of the route map embed for stories.

tools.name: list_ship_tracking
tools.description: Read verified catalog ship MMSIs, latest actual AIS positions, and fresh, stale or missing coverage. Filter by ship UUID/slug or coverage status. Older positions are last known observations, not current locations.

tools.name: get_ship_positions
tools.description: A ship's saved hourly positions (up to the latest 168 hours, newest first): time, latitude, longitude, speed, course, heading and, for imported ones, the source page. The home page map draws each ship's last 3 days from these. Missing hours are never interpolated.

tools.name: list_cruise_port_catalog
tools.description: Cruise ports by five-character UN/LOCODE, names, aliases and every connected IATA airport. Use the port code for guides and activity pages; several airports can serve one port.

tools.name: get_cruise_port_guide
tools.description: One port's saved guide: intro, things to do, high and low season months, regular callers, and the airport transfer (route, rental cars, ease).

tools.name: list_cruise_lines
tools.description: Cruise lines on Cruises Frog with their style, who they suit, fleet rating (the average of their ships' editorial scores), owner, ship count, solo cabins, and page link. Narrow by style, audience (e.g. families) or solo cabins and sort by rating to answer "best cruise line for ..." questions. For so

tools.name: get_cruise_line
tools.description: One cruise line by slug or UUID: owner, headquarters, loyalty program, website, write-up, and every ship in its fleet with page links.

tools.name: list_cruise_ships
tools.description: Cruise ships with their line, class, year, tonnage, capacity, rating, status, and page link. Narrow by line, by a region they sail (e.g. "Mediterranean"), by a name search, by minimum overall rating, or by status (in service, upcoming, retired); sort by name, size, newest, or rating.

tools.name: get_cruise_ship
tools.description: One ship by slug or UUID: every figure on record, its editorial ratings, write-up, deck plan links, cover photo, and page link.

tools.name: get_ship_metrics
tools.description: The axes a cruise ship is scored on, 1 to 5, with what a 5 means and each one's leaderboard page.

tools.name: list_cruise_regions
tools.description: Every region cruise ships sail (oceans, then rivers), what a cruise there is usually like, how many ships on Cruises Frog sail it, and its page.

tools.name: list_cruise_loyalty
tools.description: Every cruise line's loyalty program with its tier ladder and page link.

tools.name: get_cruise_loyalty
tools.description: One loyalty program by slug or UUID: each tier with what it takes to reach and its perks, how members earn credit, any status match, and the page link.

tools.name: top_cruise_ships
tools.description: Rated cruise ships best first, overall or by one metric (see get_ship_metrics), with the leaderboard's page link.

tools.name: list_cruise_news
tools.description: Cruise news, newest first, each story with the ship or line it covers and that page's link: the whole feed, one line's news (line: its own stories and its ships'), or one line's or ship's own stories (subject and ref).

tools.name: list_cruise_ports
tools.description: The ports cruise ships on Cruises Frog sail from, busiest first, identified by their five-character UN/LOCODE: port names and airport connections, how many ships are based there, how many lounges the airport has on Lounge Frog, whether the port has a guide (get_cruise_port_guide), and the port and a

tools.name: get_ship_deck_plans
tools.description: For one cruise ship: its deck plan editions by sailing dates, with the PDF and the cruise line's own source, the cabin grades, and Cruises Frog's notes on quieter cabins and cabins to check or avoid (noise from pools, theaters, galleys above or below), with the deck plan and cabins-to-avoid page lin

tools.name: get_point_value_history
tools.description: Dated cents-per-point observations and documented devaluation events, with the Points Frog program page. Estimates are not guaranteed cash value; historical observations are not interpolated.

tools.name: list_point_values
tools.description: Points Frog's estimated redemption value of one point or mile, in US cents, for airline, hotel, bank and other rewards programs, highest first, each with its program page (a balance calculator) and its award checker page. Values are estimates of what a typical good redemption gets, not cash.

tools.name: get_point_value
tools.description: One rewards program on Points Frog: its estimated value per point or mile, what 10,000, 50,000 and 100,000 are worth, the lines between a great, fair and poor award, its dated valuation history and any documented devaluations, where to buy its points, and its program page, award checker and embeddab

tools.name: value_points
tools.description: What a balance of points or miles is worth at Points Frog's value for the program. Given the cash price of the same booking (and the award's taxes and fees), also works out the cents per point the award gets and whether that is a great, fair or poor use of the points, with the program page and award

tools.name: compare_point_programs
tools.description: Two rewards programs on Points Frog compared: which is worth more per point or mile and by how much, what 10,000, 50,000 and 100,000 of each are worth, and each one's great-award line, with the comparison page and both program pages.

tools.name: best_credit_cards
tools.description: Points Frog's ranking of popular US rewards cards for one kind of spending (dining, groceries, flights, hotels, gas, streaming, everyday spending, or no annual fee): cents back per dollar, which is the card's earning rate times Points Frog's value for its points (cash back at 1 cent), with each card

tools.name: list_transfer_bonuses
tools.description: Transfer bonuses the Frog sites have reported (extra miles or points when moving bank points such as Amex Membership Rewards or Chase Ultimate Rewards to an airline or hotel program), newest first, each with its date, summary and story link, plus Points Frog's transfer bonus page.

tools.name: list_calculators
tools.description: Points Frog's free money calculators (retirement, FIRE, mortgages, rent vs buy, home affordability, house poor, loans, credit card payoff and rewards, inflation, savings, income percentile, net worth, Social Security, 401(k) match, travel budget, lounge access, countries and more) and Cruises Frog's

tools.name: get_embed_code
tools.description: The HTML that puts one of the sites' widgets on another website: a 567politics spectrum chart (page_url=https://567politics.com/political-spectrum?country=<verified-slug>), Points Frog calculator, program points value or award checker, Lounge Frog lounge card, Seats Frog seat map, or Cruises Frog sh
